name: fine-tune only a designated output layer while freezing all others
definition: Optimize a specific layer's parameters to lower the loss while leaving every other parameter frozen at the original values.
failure_mode: Any other parameter change fails the exact-match check.

name: implement a chosen-plaintext differential attack on a reduced block cipher
definition: Generate plaintext pairs under chosen differences, filter ciphertexts for a distinguishing characteristic, and accumulate subkey guesses to pin the correct low-bit round key.
failure_mode: Wrong characteristic or insufficient filtering yields a wrong subkey.
